text:
Rina: Pinging this thread with a compact one-pager draft focused on security + SLA choices across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Goal: 1-page, field-friendly, and a 30s webinar hook. Link: https://docs.google.com/pulse-brief (internal)
Noah: Saw it. Can we surface 3 quick "when to choose" signals? e.g., regulated data, predictable throughput need, or highest throughput/lowest latency?
Liam: Add a tiny benchmark panel: p95 latency for chat (short convo), cost per 1k tokens estimate for each mode. One line each.
Kara: Compliance copy: include KMS/HSM, SOC2, and audit-log retention. Keep it simple: no legalese.
Ellie: For webinar promo: 2 bullets for landing page, and a 3-slide sequence: problem, how we solve it, customer story.
Rina: I added a 3-row table: latency | predictability | isolation and a one-sentence summary under each. Also a one-line customer checklist "ask these 4 questions".
Noah: Nice. Could we include an ops microflow for failover? e.g., "if region down -> route to compatible model variant in fallback pool" with canary snippet.
Liam: I'll paste the canary rollout cron snippet: ```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  duration: 2h
  fallback: true
```
Kara: That YAML is good. Rephrase fallback text for sales: "automatic regional fallback with identical SLAs"? maybe say "near-identical" if conservative.
Ellie: Also add a 1-line finance bullet: "estimated unit cost delta vs Hosted" so procurement can estimate delta.
Rina: Draft now includes: 1) 30s elevator, 2) 3-signal decision guide, 3) benchmark panel, 4) compliance bullets, 5) CTA to schedule a Dedicated trial.
Noah: For inbound routing: I can export tags for SalesOps so leads auto-tag by deploy interest. Will add tag mapping CSV.
Liam: For the benchmark numbers I pulled the 10k messages/day ecomm and 50k/day finserv samples; flattened into one sentence each.
Kara: I left two inline edits to soften guarantees and added an escalation path for SLA breaches.
Ellie: I'll craft the 2 bullets for the webinar landing: 1) "How to balance latency, cost, and compliance" 2) "Real-world failover patterns and what to expect"
Rina: Timeline: need final one-pager by Friday morning for the webinar batch email. Who can finalize copy by Thursday EOD?
Noah: I can finalize the decision-guide and tag CSV by Thu EOD.
Liam: I'll finalize benchmarks and the YAML snippet by Thu noon.
Kara: I'll sign off on compliance language by Thu 6pm.
Ellie: I'll make the two landing bullets + 30s speaker notes by Thu 9pm.
Rina: Great. Quick checklist for the one-pager: short elevator, table of tradeoffs, 3 customer signals, benchmark blurb, compliance bullets, CTA. Keep it under 350 words.
deploy-bot: Note: linked doc updated 12 minutes ago by Rina
Rina: Thanks team. I'll merge comments and drop updated PDF here tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
